question: Are we on pace to plan this month?

content.text: No. Summit Sky Deck is behind plan on total revenue so far this month. From October 1 to October 4 (4 of 31 days), total revenue is $57,657 against a plan of $64,612, which is 89.24% of plan (red). Attendance is also behind at 1,209 against a plan of 1,334 (90.63%, amber), and per cap is $47.69 against $48.43 (98.47%, amber). Ticket revenue is the one area ahead, at $40,880 against a plan of $39,847 (102.59%, green).
